lede: Every plan of Speechify's text to speech API, how many characters each one includes each month, and the cheapest way to cover the characters you need.
calc_label: Thousands of characters you need each month
calc_note: The calculator uses Speechify's text to speech API plans (SpeechifyAI), which are priced per character; the Speechify Reader app and Speechify Studio are separate subscriptions. Past the included characters, Starter, Pro and Scale keep going from your top-up balance at $10, $8 and $6 per 1M characters, so the calculator adds that and shows the lowest total. faq: How much does the Speechify API cost?

Free is $0 with 500K characters a month. Starter is $10/month for 1.9M characters, Pro $99/month for 13.5M and Scale $499/month for 78M. Enterprise is custom. Plans are month to month, with no annual commitment.
What happens when I use up my characters?

On Starter, Pro and Scale you keep going from your top-up balance at the plan's rate: $10, $8 or $6 per 1M characters. Auto top-up is off until you switch it on. Free pauses until the next month and cannot top up.
Is the API the same as the Speechify app subscription?

No. SpeechifyAI, the developer API, is billed separately from the Speechify Reader app, whose Premium plan is $29/month or $139 billed yearly. Speechify Studio, for voiceovers and dubbing, is another subscription at $100 or $300 a year.
